top_signals.title: US Stocks Drift as Treasury Yields Resume Climb: Markets Wrap
top_signals.summary: US stocks struggled for direction while Treasury yields resumed their climb, resisting the pull from a third straight day of declining oil prices as a turbulent week drew to a close.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Commodity repricing impacting inflation expectations and industrial supply chains.

top_signals.title: Amazon’s freighter aircraft of the future is the Airbus A330
